source:
Crée un jeu de rôle (RP) dans une école hantée en vraie 3D stylisée. Les joueurs doivent survivre à un monstre qui apparaît à minuit tout en explorant des pièces cachées.
Intègre des zones réservées aux membres VIP, une boutique pour acheter des objets de défense ou des lampes de poche colorées avec des Robux, et ajoute un système de renaissances (Rebirth). Rend le décor très détaillé, lumineux et ultra fluide. »
theme: Bright, highly detailed stylized haunted school

questions.ask: Should the haunted school be a single multi-floor building with a courtyard, or a larger campus with separate buildings and outdoor grounds?
Does a round end when survivors reach dawn or a designated escape area, or should the school remain a continuous RP world with the monster returning every midnight?

answers.ask: Should the haunted school be a single multi-floor building with a courtyard, or a larger campus with separate buildings and outdoor grounds?
answers.answer: Use a single detailed multi-floor haunted school building with a courtyard, keeping the map compact and focused on hidden-room exploration.

answers.ask: Does a round end when survivors reach dawn or a designated escape area, or should the school remain a continuous RP world with the monster returning every midnight?
answers.answer: Make it a continuous RP world where the monster returns every midnight; players survive the night and continue exploring the school afterward.

scene_prompt: Create a stylized 3D haunted-school RP map as a single detailed multi-floor school building arranged around a courtyard. Keep the layout compact and focused on exploration, with interconnected classrooms, corridors, stairways, and hidden rooms throughout the building. Include physical VIP-only areas and a school shop space for defensive items and colored flashlights. The school remains a continuous explorable world, with the courtyard and interior rooms forming the central playable space.
blob:
### Genre
The dominant genre is Survival, with Roleplay & Avatar Sim as a secondary social layer. Midnight monster survival and hidden-room evasion own the spatial design; the RP setting contributes the school identity and service spaces.

### Shape and preset
Use `warren-looping`, a compact, interconnected haunted-school warren wrapped around a central courtyard, with multiple routes through classrooms, halls, and stairs so players are not trapped in dead ends. The closest preset is 1 vs All, but it is not fully recognisable because this is a continuous monster-threat world rather than asymmetric player roles or an escape round; use preset none.

### Config requirements
Use `spawner-npc` as invisible layout-only monster origin points, distributed away from the main arrival and shop spaces. Use `building-interior` as visible geometry for the enterable school rooms and the courtyard-to-school transitions. The VIP-only areas are visible, physically distinct restricted wings or lounges; the school shop is visible geometry, not a UI or economy layout requirement. Do not render monster spawn markers.

### Layout components
Build one detailed multi-floor school building enclosing a medium central courtyard. The ground floor holds the main entrance hall, the courtyard-facing circulation loop, a clearly identifiable school shop, and a separated VIP wing behind prominent access doors. Place classrooms and faculty-style rooms along the outer sides of the loop. Upper floors repeat the corridor-and-classroom structure with connected stairwells at opposing sides, creating alternate routes around the building. Scatter hidden rooms behind library shelving, false classroom walls, storage closets, and concealed corridor doors; each should reconnect to the main circulation rather than become a dead end. Keep broad, readable main hallways, with smaller side corridors and sightline-breaking classroom doorways for evasion. The courtyard is the open central relief space, with paths to each wing. Enclose the campus in the school exterior walls and building mass; frame the composition from above and slightly toward the courtyard, showing the roof-cutaway floor arrangement and the dense connected interiors.

### Render order
Use `topdown`: a valid looping route network is required so players can evade the monster without sealed or inescapable corridors; the image model should establish the plan before the isometric dressing.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is medium, driven by one compact but multi-floor building with many explorable rooms. Theme: bright, polished stylized 3D haunted school, eerie but readable, with detailed colorful lighting. Apply `P2` for stacked floors above one another, `P3` for courtyard-to-interior traversal, and `P6` because the looping chase topology must be valid by construction.

iso_prompt:
Build this scene from the attached top-down plan: Create a stylized 3D haunted-school RP map as a single detailed multi-floor school building arranged around a courtyard. Keep the layout compact and focused on exploration, with interconnected classrooms, corridors, stairways, and hidden rooms throughout the building. Include physical VIP-only areas and a school shop space for defensive items and colored flashlights. The school remains a continuous explorable world, with the courtyard and interior rooms forming the central playable space.

LAYOUT FEATURES for this Survival map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Looping Warren: Architecture built on interconnected circles with zero dead ends, so a fleeing player is never artificially cornered by pathfinding AI.

INCLUDE:
- Enterable Shelter: Buildings players flee into and hide inside. Polished square Roblox-like 3D environment concept, isometric three-quarter view, no captions or watermark.
